goal: Connect existing six-hour GitHub-native FORGE worker to automatic source-only research-advisory selection, execution of two bounded development readiness checks, evidence feedback to subsequent scheduled runs.

qualification.previous_state_source: previous completed successful scheduled main FORGE integrated run only; ZIP downloaded with SHA256 receipt; GitHub run metadata must match record run ID/commit/event, fail closed on mismatch
qualification.first_run: BOOTSTRAP_NO_PREVIOUS_F118_ARTIFACT, no claim of consecutive unattended progression
qualification.after_merge: Existing six-hour scheduled FORGE integrated workflow, no new scheduler
qualification.development_pr: PR test-merge verifies behavior but not genuine multi-run unattended continuity
qualification.selection: per-lane actual four source-bound 64hex proposal IDs; retry recent failure up to two times, otherwise least attempted; never interpret package tests as validation of candidate science
qualification.output: execute two bounded native Go package tests, feedback digest, state-chain prior report receipt, new source-bound JSON artifact
qualification.negatives: all negative/timeout tests reported and used for subsequent proposals, never source of scientific promotion
